about: Every model the system runs or keeps, with its use, inputs, outputs and known limitations. Tier: production = feeds a published number every session; backtest = feeds the backtest; research = kept for comparison, feeds nothing. test_dashboard.py checks that every listed module and artifact path exists.

models.name: Joint SPX/VIX Heston calibration
models.use: Daily fit to the SPX smile and the VIX index term structure; headline of the Calibration page and source of the Greeks surface.
models.inputs: SPX chain (two-sided OTM quotes, parity forwards), ^VIX9D/^VIX/^VIX3M/^VIX6M
models.limitations: One-factor diffusion: misses the short end; σ sits on its box ceiling in the headline fit; the VIX-options leg has weight 0.

models.name: Black–Scholes Greeks surface on the Heston smile
models.use: Vomma, vanna, vega and QV convexity by maturity and strike; the unstable-node flag.
models.inputs: Headline Heston parameters, spot, parity carry
models.limitations: Flat carry across maturities; the vomma shock is sized from the fitted σ.

models.name: β·VIX straddle marking (backtest valuation)
models.use: Prices and marks every backtest straddle at ATM vol = β × VIX with Black–Scholes.
models.inputs: VIX term structure, a constant β estimated from stored SPX chains
models.limitations: Mark-to-model: no traded prices in the window; β is held constant over 2018–2025.

models.name: Rule regime labeller (R0 / R1 / R2)
models.use: Deterministic same-day label from rv₂₀, VIX and an adaptive VVIX gate; the backtest trades it lagged one session.
models.limitations: Thresholds are fixed rules, not estimated; VVIX gaps are carried one session.

models.name: PDV realised-vol forecast
models.use: 21-day RMS-vol forecast refitted daily (purged walk-forward); the VIX − forecast spread drives S1/S1C.
models.limitations: EWMA approximation of a path-dependent-vol kernel; backward-looking, so it cannot anticipate jumps.

models.name: Delta-hedged straddle simulator (C7)
models.use: Daily Greek P&L explain of a hedged 1-year ATM straddle in 2020.
models.limitations: One path; financing at a flat rate; Black–Scholes Greeks at the VIX term structure.

models.name: Two-factor Quintic OU
models.use: Joint SPX/VIX research model compared with Heston on one session.
models.inputs: SPX chain, VIX options, VIX indices
models.limitations: Not converged (iteration limit; ε on its bound); Monte Carlo SPX pricing.

models.name: XGBoost regime classifier
models.use: Next-session regime probabilities, shown for research only.
models.limitations: Loses to the no-skill persistence baseline (C17); never trades.

models.name: Neural-network Heston pricer surrogate
models.use: Fast approximation of the Fourier pricer; on no production path.
models.limitations: Domain narrower than the calibrator's box; out-of-domain inputs are refused.

vendor_inputs.data: SPX chain, SPX closes, VIX family, ^IRX
vendor_inputs.note: Delayed, end of day; no quote timestamps on the chain.
Official index files used to correct the VIX close.
